_about: Jerry Lyons' ONE shared record of market numbers. Written by the Website market update routine (monthly, Maryland REALTORS) and the Monday website check (weekly Freddie Mac rate) at the same time they update the website. Every other agent (FB/IG market post, LinkedIn, Google Business, chat agent) reads numbers ONLY from here. Never estimate; if the month you need isn't here yet, wait. Newest month first.

mortgage_rate.source: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey
mortgage_rate.notice: Mortgage rates reflect the national average reported in Freddie Mac's Primary Mortgage Market Survey released November 12, 2026; your individual rate depends on credit, down payment, and loan type.
